answer: I would stop farms with voice anti-spoof with ultrasonic challenge tone, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. A farm running 554 aliases would need 554 separate proofs, each costing about 119 POA or 16 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. One vertex of signal, one cipher of cost, one oasis of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
